title: KKR & Co. Inc. 8-K Filing — 2026-04-24
summary: KKR & Co. Inc. filed an 8-K reporting results of a special stockholders meeting held April 21, 2026. Four of five proposals were approved, including amendments to board authority and meeting procedures. Proposal 1 to eliminate supermajority voting requirements failed to achieve the required 90% threshold, receiving 85.97% support, and the meeting was adjourned to May 21, 2026 to allow additional time for voting.
key_points: Proposal 1 (remove supermajority voting requirement) received 85.97% support but requires 90% approval; meeting adjourned to May 21, 2026
Proposal 2 (establish stockholder meetings as sole approval mechanism) approved with 59.03% of outstanding shares
Proposal 3 (grant Board sole authority to fill board vacancies) approved with 71.82% of outstanding shares
Proposal 4 (fix board size and streamline charter) approved with 70.09% of outstanding shares
Proposal 5 (adjourn meeting if needed to solicit additional proxies) approved with 63.16% of outstanding shares
Series I preferred stockholder voted For all proposals
